entities.name: Johann Philipp Anton von Frankenstein
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Philipp Anton Freiherr von und zu Franckenstein, born in Forchheim on 27 March 1695, appointed in 1743 as Vicar-General of Mainz, was from 1746 to 1753 ruling Prince-bishop of Bamberg.
